items.html: *In the Tikunim, page 9b, in the introduction, and this is its language: "And the spreading of the upper Hey, until Hod, in the letter Yod, it is," etc. Also in other places we find in the Zohar that the upper Ima spreads until Hod. And the matter, with the above, is that the spreading of the NHY of Ima within ZA, in the secret of the Mochin above, its spreading did not reach except until the Hod of ZA; but the Yesod of ZA was not made from Ima, for her Yesod did not spread except until there, as above; for the Yesod of Ima is called air, in the secret of a tower flying in the air, which we mentioned above.
